policy: Normalize export resolution uniformly; never fit individual weapon/pose bounds. Each clip keeps one body scale and authored floor anchor.

calibrationNotes.forwardFloor: 512px exports use approximately y480 for light/heavy and y482 for medium; convert these to reference coordinates once, preserving motion within each clip.
calibrationNotes.downLight: Upright source and head/torso comparison showed the entire 16-frame export approximately 23 percent oversized after resolution normalization. A single 0.81 correction keeps its measured head scale within 7 percent of idle; its authored floor is y488 of 512.
calibrationNotes.poseShape: Crouches, lunges, jumps, and ball spins retain their natural silhouette changes. Skin measurements are diagnostics, not per-frame auto-scaling or motion approval.
